topic: Syncing staging data to production environment
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on discrepancies found in analytics reporting. Specifically, [p1] noted that the traffic data for a specific facility (27079) did not match when comparing the master facility view versus selecting multiple individual facilities (27083, 27086, 27081, 27080).

Later, [p1] requested that staging data for company 7894, starting from August 1, 2023, be copied to the production environment. This action was completed by [me].
decisions: Staging analytics data for company 7894 (starting 2023-08-01) was successfully copied to production.
